libheif-js 1.23.5 (https://github.com/catdad-experiments/libheif-js), libheif compiled to WebAssembly.
Licence: LGPL-3.0 (LICENSE). Source: https://github.com/strukturag/libheif
Used only to show a preview of a HEIC / HEIF photo in browsers that can't open one (assets/js/services/upload-service.js).
The photo itself is uploaded unchanged. To update: copy libheif-wasm/libheif-bundle.js from the libheif-js package.
